entities.name: ArgJ acetyltransferase
observations: 387 aa; calculated molecular mass 41.93 kDa and pI 5.31.
Pfam ArgJ domain PF01960.24 spans residues 16–387 with i-Evalue 8.2e-140.
Closest reviewed homologs are ArgJ proteins with 49.7–52.1% identity and 97.9–99.5% coverage.
ArgJ homologs are bifunctional ornithine acetyltransferases in cyclic arginine biosynthesis and undergo autolytic cleavage near the catalytic nucleophile.
Likely cytoplasmic enzyme; exact organism and experimental confirmation are unavailable from the sequence alone.

entities.name: ArgJ transacetylation
observations: N(2)-acetyl-L-ornithine + L-glutamate ⇌ N-acetyl-L-glutamate + L-ornithine; associated with RHEA:15349 in close ArgJ homologs.

entities.name: ArgJ glutamate acetylation
observations: L-glutamate + acetyl-CoA ⇌ N-acetyl-L-glutamate + CoA + H(+); associated with RHEA:24292 in close ArgJ homologs.
The reaction assignment is homology-supported rather than directly experimentally demonstrated for this query sequence.

entities.name: Cyclic arginine biosynthesis
observations: ArgJ homologs participate in the cyclic route to L-arginine, supplying N-acetyl-L-glutamate and L-ornithine from glutamate and acetylated ornithine.
